item.title: Manatee County commissioners approve 80 homes on 18th Avenue East
item.description: After a unanimous recommendation for denial by the planning commission, Manatee County commissioners approved an 80-home development along 18th Avenue East near its intersection with Morgan Johnson Road.Bradenton Estates II was approved at Thursday’s land use meeting in a 4-3 vote with commissioners Bob McCann, Carol Felts and Amanda Ballard in opposition. item.title: Sarasota will honor memory of longtime police dog
item.description: Sarasota Police will pause on Tuesday to honor Coti, a retired department police dog who served from 2014 to 2021.The 12-year-old German shepherd who worked with Officer Nick Dominis died Sunday.To honor Coti’s work with the city, Dominis and the K-9 Unit will provide Coti with a final ride past Sarasota Police headquarters at 2:15 p.m. Tuesday in the Chevrolet Tahoe patrol vehicle the two shared throughout their time together.Members of the community are invited to join the salute along Adams L

item.title: County commissioners question if Manatee Planning Commission needs rehaul
item.description: Parrish’s Anthony Sciullo is Manatee County’s latest planning commissioner.Sciullo was appointed by commissioners during the Feb. 12 land use meeting, one day after the planning commission was the topic of discussion at a commission work session. While nothing is binding at a work session, commissioners agreed that citizens who serve on the planning commission should be given a small stipend to cover lunch on meeting days and four alternates should be seated. item.title: A new community provides a place to age in place
item.description: Erickson Senior Living saw the need for a continuing care retirement community in Lakewood Ranch. But it didn’t just dive into the market right away.Instead, the Baltimore company, which operates two dozen managed-care communities in 11 states, spent time studying a potential piece of property and conducting focus groups with area residents. item.description: The town of Longboat Key is hoping to host a meeting with Sarasota-Bradenton International Airport leaders to discuss potential flight path impacts to the barrier island.Longboat Key is across from Sarasota Bay from the airport, and a flight path altered in May 2024 has led to concerns from those under the new path about air quality and particulates. item.title: Payne Park Auditorium renovations set to begin soon
item.description: Nearly a century after its founding, and following five years of a somewhat nomadic existence, The Sarasota Players has embarked on a renewed focus of its core principals.That begins with the renovation of its new performance space in Payne Park Auditorium, which the organization has leased from the city of Sarasota. item.title: Traffic resumes normal flow after Sarasota crash
item.description: 11:03 a.m. TuesdayAll lanes are reopened and traffic is flowing normally.9:17 a.m. TuesdaySarasota Police and fire-rescue units are working at the scene of a traffic crash on U.S. 41 at Bahia Vista Street, and southbound lanes are closed.Sarasota Police said drivers should avoid the area.Southbound lanes were shut down around 8:15 a.m. at Floyd Street, between Bahia Vista and the Sarasota Memorial Hospital campus.
